2607.21306.title: AI Assistants Overassist
2607.21306.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as tutors and thought partners, helping users reason through problems. While guidance from AI assistants can scaffold thinking and foster learning, such benefits depend on how they help--for instance, intervening too early or too frequently may hinder true learning and cognitive engagement. Yet how AI systems navigate intervention decisions during problem-solving remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce Int-Bench, a simulation-based benchmark for evaluating LLM interventions during learning. Int-Bench simulates a "student" solving a problem while a "teacher" monitors the student's reasoning and decides whether, when, and how to intervene. Across three domains--code debugging, mathematics, and brain teasers--we evaluate LLM teachers on the frequency and timing of interventions, as well as their impact on both immediate task success and generalization to new problems. We also compare LLMs to humans, finding that LLMs intervene more frequently and earlier than humans. Moreover, in contrast to humans, they tend to provide complete solutions rather than targeted hints. These findings suggest that current LLM assistants often optimize for short-term success rather than supporting the reasoning processes needed for deeper learning and long-term success.
2607.21306.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被用作導師和思考夥伴，幫助用戶解決問題。<lb/>雖然來自 AI 助手的指導可以支撐思考並促進學習，但這些好處取決於它們的幫助方式——例如，過早或過頻繁的干預可能會妨礙真正的學習和認知參與。<lb/>然而，AI 系統在問題解決過程中如何進行干預決策仍然不甚了解。<lb/>在此，我們介紹了 Int-Bench，一個基於模擬的基準，用於評估 LLM 在學習過程中的干預。<lb/>Int-Bench 模擬一個「學生」在解決問題的同時，「教師」監控學生的推理並決定是否、何時以及如何進行干預。<lb/>在三個領域——代碼調試、數學和腦筋急轉彎中——我們評估 LLM 教師的干預頻率和時機，以及它們對於即時任務成功和對新問題的泛化的影響。<lb/>我們還將 LLM 與人類進行比較，發現 LLM 的干預頻率和時機均高於人類。<lb/>此外，與人類相比，它們傾向於提供完整的解決方案，而不是針對性的提示。<lb/>這些發現表明，目前的 LLM 助手往往優化短期成功，而不是支持深入學習和長期成功所需的推理過程。
